overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action: no violation on the posting date/time, but a violation for omitting the trash abatement list from the August 11 notice, found unintentional.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the posted notice for the August 11 meeting lacked the date and time it was posted.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law in this regard.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the August 11 notice failed to identify the specific trash abatement applications to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Next, we find, as the Board acknowledges, that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to include in its meeting notice a list of the trash abatement matters to be discussed at the August 11 meeting.
